summary.name: 跨赴科技 (Kuafu AI / CodeFlying)
summary.one_liner: Chinese AI-native development company whose products are CodeFlying (natural-language app generation) and AiPexBase (AI-native backend-as-a-service).
use_cases: Generating a mini program or app from a plain-language description
Publishing an app to WeChat mini programs, APP and website
Getting backend data storage without writing server code
Building apps by voice on HarmonyOS devices
Adding AI extensions to a vibe-coded app via SDK skills
summary.what_it_does: The page describes two products. CodeFlying (码上飞) uses a self-developed multi-agent framework where agents handle requirement analysis, UI design, code generation and testing from a natural-language request, with stated delivery in about 10 minutes and one-click deployment to mini program, APP and website. AiPexBase is presented as a backend-as-a-service for vibe-coding developers, offering data read/write through an SDK and Skill extensions, plus one-click preview publishing. The page also lists ecosystem partnerships: CodeFlying integrated with Huawei's Xiaoyi voice assistant, AiPexBase as the core engine behind Huawei Claw, and CodeFlying among Baidu AI Search's first integrated partners.
notable: Natural-language app generation claimed to take about 10 minutes, with a multi-agent team of hundreds of agents
AiPexBase described as China's first AI-native BaaS, with an SDK and Skill ecosystem
Powers Huawei Claw's backend and is integrated with Huawei Xiaoyi voice assistant
Company says it contributed to three national standards
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Performance and delivery-time claims are marketing statements with no independent evidence on the page
Page is mostly promotional; the product's platform support beyond the named items is not detailed
